fields: h, intro, points [{t, d, fig}]. fig (optional): figure, method, report, approval, the zone's drawing (default by order).
best_for: RecordAnatomy explains what a published record carries as a drawing sheet: the title large in the sheet's open half, four specimen drawings in a drawing field (one per point, none carrying a value), and the points themselves as the sheet's title block, so every published figure reads as signed off like a drawing.

block.intro: Each published figure will carry four things your team can check.

points.d: Measured value, unit and temperature, against the pharmacopoeia limit.
Sampling point, number of samples and period.
Executed acceptance test or qualification report, with its number.
A second engineer checks it [confirm]; the client's quality unit approves the text in writing, deviations included.
